direction: Trading Card (see DESIGN.md). A short app landing: the hero picture is the play mat, a real fragment of the app (data-ui).

why.few-pictures: No stock photos of people (PRODUCT.md). The pictures are the Qloo posters on the dealt cards inside the play mat.
why.no-footage: A short app landing; no honest clip fits, and a video of people would be stock.
why.still-page: Motion is the card deal on the play mat only, with a reduced-motion fallback. The audience includes anxious and neurodivergent people; a scroll-driven motion layer would work against Easy-Read.
